title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, level by level).
hints: BFS with a queue. Process nodes level by level. For each level, get the current queue size, process that many nodes, and add their children.
Initialize queue with root. While queue not empty: record size, create level array, for i in 0..size: pop node, add to level, push children. Push level to result.
Alternatively use DFS with level parameter and append to result[level].
O(n) time, O(n) space for the queue.
